capturas.sql: DECLARE @p INT = (SELECT PedidoId FROM Pedidos WHERE PedidoOfflineGuid = '6A1F0C11-0000-4000-8000-000000000302'); IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Pedidos WHERE PedidoId = @p AND InventarioDescontado = 1) BEGIN UPDATE pr SET pr.Stock = pr.Stock + d.Cantidad FROM Productos pr JOIN PedidoDetalle d ON d.ProductoId = pr.ProductoId WHERE d.PedidoId = @p; DELETE FROM MovimientosInventario WHERE Motivo LIKE CONCAT(N'Pedido #', @p, N' liberado por %'); DELETE fd FROM FacturaDetalle fd JOIN Facturas f ON f.FacturaId = fd.FacturaId WHERE f.PedidoId = @p; DELETE FROM Facturas WHERE PedidoId = @p; END; UPDATE Pedidos SET Estado = N'Retenido', InventarioDescontado = 0, MotivoRechazo = NULL WHERE PedidoOfflineGuid IN ('6A1F0C11-0000-4000-8000-000000000302', '6A1F0C11-0000-4000-8000-000000000303');
